label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (XSS) alert-TP: User input via param flows through bar -> input -> new String -> encodeForHTML -> response.getWriter(). Although encodeForHTML is applied, the resolved sink value still contains attacker-controlled data that could exploit edge cases (event handlers, attributes). Alert 2 (stack-trace-exposure) alert-TP: e.printStackTrace(response.getWriter()) exposes stack traces to client. Alert 3 (weak-crypto) alert-TP: Default fallback to AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding is cryptographically weak. Multiple independent vulnerabilities confirmed.

evidence.note: User param flows to bar, then to input, then encoded and written to response
